dose_adult.indication: Insônia com dificuldade para iniciar o sono (tratamento de curto prazo)
dose_adult.note: Dose inicial: 5 mg para mulheres e 5 ou 10 mg para homens, porque a depuração é menor em mulheres; uma vez por noite, ao deitar. Idosos ou debilitados e insuficiência hepática leve a moderada: 5 mg.

cite.quote: The recommended initial dose is 5 mg for women and either 5 or 10 mg for men, taken only once per night immediately before bedtime with at least 7–8 hours remaining before the planned time of awakening.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "The total dose of AMBIEN should not exceed 10 mg once daily immediately before bedtime." e "The recommended initial doses for women and men are different because zolpidem clearance is lower in women."

facts.note: Contraindicado em quem já teve comportamento complexo do sono com AMBIEN (seção 4).

cite.quote: Complex sleep behaviors including sleep-walking, sleep-driving, and engaging in other activities while not fully awake may occur following use of AMBIEN. Some of these events may result in serious injuries, including death.

cite.locator: seção 5.2 CNS-Depressant Effects and Next-Day Impairment
cite.quote: Coadministration with other CNS depressants (e.g., benzodiazepines, opioids, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol) increases the risk of CNS depression
cite.note: Seção 7.1: "The concomitant use of AMBIEN with opioids may increase the risk of respiratory depression."

cite.locator: seção 5.2 CNS-Depressant Effects and Next-Day Impairment
cite.quote: Vehicle drivers and machine operators should be warned that, as with other hypnotics, there may be a possible risk of adverse reactions including drowsiness, prolonged reaction time, dizziness, sleepiness, blurred/double vision, reduced alertness, and impaired driving the morning after therapy.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Because AMBIEN can cause drowsiness and a decreased level of consciousness, patients, particularly the elderly, are at higher risk of falls."

cite.quote: Use of AMBIEN may lead to the development of physical and/or psychological dependence. The risk of dependence increases with dose and duration of treatment.
cite.note: Seção 5.9: "Monitor patients for tolerance, abuse, and dependence"

cite.quote: There have been reports of withdrawal signs and symptoms following the rapid dose decrease or abrupt discontinuation of zolpidem.

facts.note: A bula relata desfechos fatais em superdosagem de zolpidem isolado ou combinado com depressores do SNC; não quantifica a toxicidade.

cite.quote: In postmarketing experience of overdose with zolpidem tartrate alone, or in combination with CNS-depressant agents, impairment of consciousness ranging from somnolence to coma, cardiovascular and/or respiratory compromise, and fatal outcomes have been reported.
cite.note: Seção 5.6 (pacientes deprimidos): "Intentional overdosage is more common in this group of patients; therefore, the lowest number of tablets that is feasible should be prescribed for the patient at any one time."

cite.quote: Avoid AMBIEN use in patients with severe hepatic impairment as it may contribute to encephalopathy
cite.note: Seção 2.2: na insuficiência hepática leve a moderada, a dose recomendada é 5 mg.

cite.locator: seção 7.2 Drugs that Affect Drug Metabolism via Cytochrome P450
cite.quote: Ketoconazole, a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor, increased the exposure to and pharmacodynamic effects of zolpidem. Consideration should be given to using a lower dose of zolpidem when a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor and zolpidem are given together
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Use of Rifampin in combination with zolpidem may decrease the efficacy of zolpidem and is not recommended"

cite.quote: Neonates born to mothers using zolpidem late in the third trimester of pregnancy have been reported to experience symptoms of respiratory depression and sedation
There are reports of excess sedation in infants exposed to zolpidem through breastmilk
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Infants exposed to AMBIEN through breastmilk should be monitored for excess sedation, hypotonia, and respiratory depression."

cite.locator: seção 6.1 Clinical Trials Experience (Most Commonly Observed Adverse Reactions in Controlled Trials)
cite.quote: During short-term treatment (up to 10 nights) with AMBIEN at doses up to 10 mg, the most commonly observed adverse reactions associated with the use of zolpidem and seen at statistically significant differences from placebo-treated patients were drowsiness (reported by 2% of zolpidem patients), dizziness (1%), and diarrhea (1%).
cite.note: Mesma seção: "During longer-term treatment (28 to 35 nights) with zolpidem at doses up to 10 mg, the most commonly observed adverse reactions associated with the use of zolpidem and seen at statistically significant differences from placebo-treated patients were dizziness (5%) and drugged feelings (3%)."

common_effects.note: Insônia, uso curto (até 10 noites). No uso por 28 a 35 noites: tontura (5%) e sensação de estar drogado (3%), que não tem id.

review.notes: Sem opioid_coadministration_warning: o único boxed warning do AMBIEN é o de comportamentos complexos do sono; o risco com opioides (5.7, 7.1) está em cns_depressant. Fora por falta de id: angioedema/anafilaxia (5.4), piora de depressão e ideação suicida em deprimidos (5.6), depressão respiratória em apneia do sono e miastenia (5.7), alterações de comportamento (5.5). Sem fato renal: a seção 12.3 diz que não é preciso ajustar a dose. overdose_toxicity_high é decisão de leitura: conferir.
